content: The email has been sent; I do not plan to follow up.
I see an email from someone named Jordan Reyes referencing my Cost Plus Drugs pricing playbook and asking for a 15-minute call. I note it's a cold pitch.
I recall that many cold emails waste my time, but the reference to Cost Plus Drugs makes me slightly more inclined to read it.
I am slightly intrigued but still skeptical; I want to filter out time-wasters by requesting a concise pitch.
I've decided to engage minimally; if the summary is compelling, I might consider a call.
I've decided to give Jordan a chance to convince me briefly, but I'm not committing to anything yet.
